# Validate: Custom Formats - validates radarr/sonarr custom-format JSON files against their schemas and checks cross-file consistency.
# Triggers: push to master or pull requests touching custom-format JSON/schema files, or manual dispatch.
name: "Validate: Custom Formats"
run-name: "${{ github.workflow }} · ${{ github.event_name }}"

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/custom-format-validation.yml
      - docs/json/guide-only/*.json
      - docs/json/radarr/cf/*.json
      - docs/json/sonarr/cf/*.json
      - docs/json/radarr/conflicts.json
      - docs/json/sonarr/conflicts.json
      - schemas/**/*.json
      - scripts/validate-source-specifications.py
      - tests/test_validate_source_specifications.py
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/custom-format-validation.yml
      - docs/json/guide-only/*.json
      - docs/json/radarr/cf/*.json
      - docs/json/sonarr/cf/*.json
      - docs/json/radarr/conflicts.json
      - docs/json/sonarr/conflicts.json
      - schemas/**/*.json
      - scripts/validate-source-specifications.py
      - tests/test_validate_source_specifications.py
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate-json:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.x"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: .github/requirements-ci.txt

      - name: Install check-jsonschema
        run: pip install -r .github/requirements-ci.txt

      - name: Validate Guide only Custom Formats
        run: check-jsonschema -v --schemafile schemas/guide-only-cf.schema.json docs/json/guide-only/*.json

      - name: Validate Radarr Custom Formats
        run: check-jsonschema -v --schemafile schemas/radarr-cf.schema.json docs/json/radarr/cf/*.json

      - name: Validate Sonarr Custom Formats
        run: check-jsonschema -v --schemafile schemas/sonarr-cf.schema.json docs/json/sonarr/cf/*.json

      - name: Validate Conflicts
        run: |
          for f in docs/json/radarr/conflicts.json docs/json/sonarr/conflicts.json; do
            [ -f "$f" ] && check-jsonschema -v --schemafile schemas/conflicts.schema.json "$f"
          done

      - name: Validate custom format consistency
        run: python scripts/validate-custom-formats.py

      - name: Validate SourceSpecification per-app values
        run: python scripts/validate-source-specifications.py

      - name: Test source and modifier validation
        run: python -m unittest tests/test_validate_source_specifications.py

      - name: Validate changed Radarr Remux specifications

          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "$BASE_SHA" ]]; then
            echo "Manual dispatch; validating all Radarr Remux specifications."

            echo "Initial branch push; skipping

jobs:

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
